summary: Husted voted Nay on discharging S.J. Res. 32 and S.J. Res. 138, blocking floor votes to disapprove U.S. military sales to Israel that included D9 bulldozers and 1,000-lb bomb bodies. VoteLog scored him +14 pro-Israel across four cosponsorships and six aligned floor votes, with no recorded pro-Palestine activity. He praised the October 2025 ceasefire and credited Trump for it, and Vote for Peace rated him Opposed in the primary.
